name: breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: WAI-ARIA 1.2 breadcrumb trail (nav > ol > li) with a decorative › separator, aria-current=page on the final crumb, and an optional truncate threshold that collapses the middle crumbs behind an ellipsis button (fires hbd:expand). Dual API: compound Breadcrumbs + Breadcrumbs.Item, or a data-driven items[] prop.
